lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh keejai kripaa nidhaan ham har gun gaavahage ||
lines.translation: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless me, that I may sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tumaree karau nit aas prabh mohi kab gal laavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I always place my hopes in You; O God, when will you take me in Your Embrace? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik mugadh iaan pitaa samajhaavahige ||
lines.translation: I am a foolish and ignorant child; Father, please teach me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sut khin khin bhool bigaar jagat pit bhaavahige ||1||
lines.translation: Your child makes mistakes again and again, but still, You are pleased with him, O Father of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਪਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har suaamee tum dehu soee ham paavahage ||
lines.translation: Whatever You give me, O my Lord and Master - that is what I receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mohi doojee naahee thaur jis pahi ham jaavahage ||2||
lines.translation: There is no other place where I can go. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har bhaavahi bhagat tinaa har bhaavahige ||
lines.translation: Those devotees who are pleasing to the Lord - the Lord is pleasing to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot milaai jot ral jaavahage ||3||
lines.translation: Their light merges into the Light; the lights are merged and blended together. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape hoi kripaal aap liv laavahige ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself has shown mercy; He lovingly attunes me to Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran duaar har laaj rakhaavahige ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Door of the Lord, who protects his honor. ||4||6|| First Set of Six ||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਭੋਪਾਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan bhopaalee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan Bhopaalee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham paramesur suaamee dookh nivaaran naaraaine ||
lines.translation: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord and Master, Destroyer of pain, Transcendental Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bhagat jaachahi sukh saagar bhav nidh taran har chi(n)taamane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All Your devotees beg of You. Ocean of peace, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean; You are the Wish-fulfilling Jewel. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal jagadees damodar har a(n)tarajaamee gobi(n)de ||
lines.translation: Merciful to the meek and poor, Lord of the world, Support of the earth, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: te nirabhau jin sreeraam dhiaaiaa guramat muraar har muka(n)de ||1||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Supreme Lord become fearless. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, they meditate on the Lord, the Liberator Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਜੋ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagadeesur charan saran jo aae te jan bhav nidh paar pare ||
lines.translation: Those who come to Sanctuary at the Feet of the Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kee paij har raakhai jan naanak aap har kripaa kare ||2||1||7||
lines.translation: The Lord preserves the honor of His humble devotees; O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself showers them with His Grace. ||2||1||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag kaliaan mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਹ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaarai eh kirapaa keejai ||
lines.translation: Please grant me this blessing:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: al makara(n)d charan kamal siu man pher pher reejhai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: May the bumble-bee of my mind be immersed again and again in the Honey of Your Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਜਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan jalaa siu kaaj na kachhooai har boo(n)d chaatrik kau deejai ||1||
lines.translation: I am not concerned with any other water; please bless this songbird with a Drop of Your Water, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin milabe naahee sa(n)tokhaa pekh darasan naanak jeejai ||2||1||
lines.translation: Unless I meet my Lord, I am not satisfied. Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaachik naam jaachai jaachai ||
lines.translation: This beggar begs and begs for Your Name, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab dhaar sarab ke naaik sukh samooh ke daate ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Support of all, the Master of all, the Giver of absolute peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਭਾਵਨੀਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ketee ketee maa(n)gan maagai bhaavaneeaa so paaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: So many, so very many, beg for charity at Your Door; they receive only what You are pleased to give. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੇ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal saphal saphal daras re paras paras gun gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Fruitful, fruitful, fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; touching His Touch, I sing His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tat tat siu mileeai heerai heer bidhaaeeai ||2||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one's essence is blended into the Essence; the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the Diamond of the Lord. ||2||2||
